question.question: What is the scientific decision for Hibiscus sabdariffa for Mild-to-moderate hypertension?

records.notes: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 13 randomized trials found Hibiscus sabdariffa significantly reduced systolic and diastolic blood pressure versus placebo in mild-to-moderate hypertension; effects were not significant in the metabolic-syndrome subgroup and further RCTs are required to define long-term efficacy and who benefits most.
records.source_title: Efficacy of Hibiscus sabdariffa on Reducing Blood Pressure in Patients With Mild-to-Moderate Hypertension

records.notes: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial found hibiscus tea lowered systolic blood pressure versus placebo after six weeks, while the diastolic difference was not statistically significant.
records.source_title: Hibiscus sabdariffa L. tea lowers blood pressure in prehypertensive and mildly hypertensive adults
